title: Retry Storms, Circuit Breakers, and Rate Limits Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies retry storms, circuit breakers, and rate limits?
options: Centralise bounded idempotent retries and protect recovery with jitter, coalescing, circuits and capacity limits.
questions.answer: Centralise bounded idempotent retries and protect recovery with jitter, coalescing, circuits and capacity limits.
questions.explanation: This answer preserves the underlying platform or delivery contract while requiring representative evidence, explicit failure behaviour, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: A circuit breaker guarantees queued operations eventually succeed.
questions.explanation: Adding exponential backoff inside both an interceptor and WorkManager can multiply attempts and create delays or load no owner understands.

questions.prompt: Why is jitter essential during widespread failure?
questions.answer: It desynchronises clients so they do not retry together and recreate the overload spike.
questions.explanation: The response identifies the mechanism that makes the decision reliable instead of relying on a convenient proxy.
